audit_items.proof_trace: The config layer (admin/emode.move::create_emode_params_inner L179) allows flash_loan_fee_rate_bps=0 without a minimum check. However, the runtime check at market.move:813-814 computes fee = flash_loan_fee_rate.int_mul(amount) and asserts fee != 0; since int_mul(Decimal{0}, n) = (0*n)/WAD = 0, any flash loan with a zero configured rate aborts with reserve_flash_loan_fee_too_small. The security invariant (no free flash loans) is therefore enforced at runtime even when the rate is misconfigured to zero.
